title: The Robot That Can't See You

slices.alt: Comic, part 1 of 12: Verdict Picks Toon: The Robot That Can't See You Caption: Black Friday week, 11:48 p.m. Sam: Robot vacuums are on sale. Goodbye, dog hair!

Comic, part 2 of 12: Phone screen: TECH NEWS Photos taken by test robot vacuums were posted online (2022).  Hacked robots showed live camera feeds (2026). Caption: As reported by MIT Technology Review (2022) and Tom's Hardware (2026).
Comic, part 3 of 12: (Sound: !!) Sam: Wait. My vacuum would have a CAMERA?
Comic, part 4 of 12: Vera: Some do. A camera lets a robot see a sock and steer around it.

Comic, part 5 of 12: Caption: A robot without a camera maps your home with a spinning laser: LiDAR. Caption: It measures the distance to walls and furniture. It never takes a photo, and it works in the dark.
Comic, part 6 of 12: Sam: Then no camera, no problem! Vera: Mostly.
Comic, part 7 of 12: Caption: It scans at the height of its turret. It sees the sofa, not the sock on the floor. (Sound: SHRRRK)

Comic, part 8 of 12: Board, CNET lab test, November 13, 2026: Camera-free Roomba 205 Combo avoided 1 of 6; Roomba Combo 10 Max (camera) avoided 6 of 6 Source: CNET, best robot vacuums of 2026 (lab test by Ajay Kumar). (Sound: ?) Vera: And no camera-free robot in our guide promises to avoid pet waste.
Comic, part 9 of 12: Sam: MY DOG IS A PUPPY!
Comic, part 10 of 12: Board, Which robot for your home?: Tidy floor, privacy first no camera; Puppy, sick pet, cords camera robot Vera: Pick by your floor, not by the ad.
Comic, part 11 of 12: Caption: Next morning. The 30-second rule: cords and socks off the floor before every run. Sam: Floor's clear. Go, robot.

Comic, part 12 of 12: Vera: One more thing: a laser robot still sends your floor map to the cloud. Vera: So skip the data-sharing program in the app. Which camera-free robot should you buy? Six picks, compared below.
